name: wait_for_text_window_input

stack.evidence: func_001CDFC8 takes no values from Script stackTop and returns pending state 4 while a non-system text window remains active and Script flag bit 0x10 is clear

notes: func_001CDFC8 scans the four active text-window slots, excluding window ID 7, and returns state 2 immediately when no applicable window is active or event-state bit 0x1 in D_00375BC0 is set. All 63 JP calls occur after opening and populating a text window.
